proof_summary: For the composite squarefree number \(n=23492890653051=3\cdot37\cdot43\cdot42307\cdot116341\), the identity \(\sum_{k=1}^n\gcd(k,n)=\sum_{d\mid n}\varphi(d)(n/d)\) and multiplicativity give the value \(610815156979325\). Thus one plus this gcd-sum is \(610815156979326=26n\), so its gcd with \(n\) is \(n\), producing the required composite counterexample.
